_about: The home page's gallery (public_site.showcase): image ads and video ads in one grid, in this order. Only our own generated work goes here: no stock, no other companies' ads, no real people. Put each file in this folder (or, for a clip, in the library store: see _store) and add one entry to items; the first SHOWCASE_MAX (16) are shown on the home page (keep videos and pictures mixed there, never more than two videos in a row); the app's Inspiration shows the rest too.

_shape.preset: the preset id that made it, when one did (its name becomes the tile's title)
_shape.title: the tile's title when there is no preset, e.g. Presenter video
_shape.caption: one short line under the title
_shape.alt: what the picture or clip shows, for screen readers
_shape.poster: videos only: a still in this folder, shown before the clip loads
_shape.presenter: videos only: true when a person is on screen; the tile is tagged AI presenter
_shape.sound: videos only: true when the clip has speech; the tile gets a Sound button
_shape.group: optional: local for a local business or service (roofing, a salon, a food truck); the app's Inspiration lists those together
_shape.store: optional, videos: {sha256, bytes} of a file that lives in the library store instead of this folder (libstore.py). Its poster still goes in this folder.

_sizes: Images: JPEG or WebP, 1080 px on the short side, under 400 KB. Videos: MP4 (H.264), 540x960, 5 to 10 seconds, under 600 KB (about 400 kbit/s), each with a poster. Everything here rides in the deploy bundle, which has a size limit (tests/test_bundle_size.py), so keep clips small. A mix of images and videos fills the grid best; at most 16 are shown on the home page.

_store._about: Where store items come from (libstore.py): this repository's own tree at exactly this commit. An item with a store block is not in this folder or the deploy bundle; the server fetches it once and keeps it only if its size and SHA-256 match.
